title: Anywhere Reader
user: A blind or low-vision person using a locked-down work, school, kiosk, or game computer who needs to hear the currently visible UI without installing software on that computer.
smallest_useful_product: Android app that photographs/streams a selected screen region, performs on-device OCR, reads only changed lines on a push-to-talk gesture, and offers large high-contrast zoom.
success_measure: In a 10-person pilot, at least 7 complete a three-step task on an unmanaged visual-only app without sighted help in under five minutes.
constraints: All OCR/audio must stay on device by default; obtain clear consent before any camera capture; do not defeat DRM, authentication, or employer monitoring controls; accessibility-tree integration is optional only.
